name: CIVPAY Q&A - Stale Review Guard
description: Monthly upkeep flow for the CIVPAY Q&A List. Flags any answer whose citation has not been re-verified within the review window (default 180 days) and emails a digest to the list owner. Keeps the citation-grounded set from silently going stale after DCPS/FMR/CFR updates. Read-only against the source of record — it reminds, it does not edit answers. Modeled on Work/BSO18_PowerPlatform/Power_Automate_Flow.json.

SiteUrl.description: SharePoint site hosting the CIVPAY Q&A list

actions.name: Get_Stale_Items
actions.comment: Only rows older than the review window. Server-side OData filter keeps the pull small.

actions.name: Build_Digest_Html
actions.inputs:
@concat('

', length(variables('varStaleRows')), ' CIVPAY Q&A answer(s) are past the ', parameters('ReviewWindowDays'), '-day review window and should be re-verified against the current source of record.

', join(select(variables('varStaleRows'), concat('')), ''), '
QuestionCitationSystemLast Reviewed
', item()?['Question'], '', item()?['Citation'], '', item()?['System'], '', item()?['LastReviewed'], '

Re-verify each against DCPS R26-1 / DoD FMR Vol 8 / 5 CFR / OPM GPPA, then update the LastReviewed date on the row.

')

notes: LastReviewed is set at import from data/civpay_qa.csv; the flow only READS it.
To change cadence edit trigger.recurrence; to change the window edit ReviewWindowDays.
This flow does not touch Answer/Citation — content changes go through the Tower authoring generator, re-export, and re-import (see IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md).
